intervals.quote: First proposed in 2014, the first phase for the development of SUPL was provided through $1.75 million funding in the 2015 Australian federal budget, matched by an equal grant from the Victorian state government.

intervals.label: construction
intervals.note: Construction started in 2016 (year only); the page says work was delayed by mine mergers and reduced to care and maintenance in December 2016, and that the project resumed in 2019 under a memorandum of understanding signed in July 2019. End: construction 'completed in August 2022'.
intervals.quote: Construction started 2016 and was expected to be complete in 2017, however was delayed by a series of corporate mergers at the gold mine in 2015 and 2016.

intervals.label: operating (laboratory completed and officially unveiled)
intervals.note: Month precision. Hosts the SABRE South detector, being assembled; no source read gives a later facility closure.
intervals.quote: The Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory (SUPL) was officially unveiled in August 2022.

name: Stawell Underground Physics Laboratory
notes: Depth and overburden are on the site record. The laboratory's own page gives no depth figure; the depth comes from the SABRE South papers.

operator_text.quote: SUPL Ltd has been established as a not-for-profit company limited by guarantee to operate the facility
operator_text.value: SUPL Ltd, a not-for-profit company limited by guarantee (founding members: the Australian National University, the University of Melbourne, Adelaide University, Swinburne University of Technology and ANSTO)

summary.plain: Australia's first deep underground physics laboratory, inside the Stawell Gold Mine in Victoria, about a kilometre below the surface. The rock overhead blocks cosmic rays, so it can host very sensitive experiments such as SABRE South, a dark matter search in the Southern Hemisphere.
summary.technical: Underground laboratory at 1024 m depth (about 2900 m water equivalent) in the Stawell Gold Mine, western Victoria, reached by a decline (helical access road); 260 m^2 of precision laboratory space, about half occupied by SABRE South. Operated by SUPL Ltd; construction completed and laboratory unveiled August 2022.
